summary: NervGen Pharma Corp. filed a Form 6-K on June 1, 2026, reporting an underwritten public offering of 24 million common shares and warrants. The offering price is US$2.50 per share-warrant unit; warrants are exercisable at US$3.68 for five years. Gross proceeds total ~US$60M. Joint bookrunners are Leerink Partners and TD Securities. Proceeds fund clinical studies for NVG-291 and working capital. Insider PFP Biosciences participated, exempt from formal valuation/minority approval under MI 61-101 as the related-party transaction is below 25% market cap. This is a capital-raising event, not a special situation.
